name: Transfermarkt
download_availability: Via web scraping or open-source scrapers
python_requests_compatibility: Requires headers and rate-limiting (to avoid IP bans)
data_quality: High for transfers/demographics, market values are estimates
missing_data_risks: Undisclosed fees, missing contract lengths for older transfers
licensing: Web scraping for academic/personal use generally tolerated; strictly non-commercial without licensing agreement
intended_purpose: Target variable (transfer fees), baseline market value, player demographic data, and transfer history.

name: FBref (via Opta/StatsBomb)
api_availability: Scraping only (e.g., via soccerdata or worldfootballR packages)
download_availability: CSV exports available per table, or programmatically via Python
python_requests_compatibility: Yes, with strict rate limiting (20 requests per minute recommended)
missing_data_risks: Advanced stats (xG, xA, pressures) only available post-2017/18 season.
licensing: Sports Reference Data Use Policy (requires attribution, non-commercial scraping with limits)
commercial_academic_use: Academic/Research: Yes. Commercial: Prohibited without Opta/SportsRef license.
intended_purpose: Core performance metrics, expected goals (xG/xA), advanced passing/defensive stats, per-90 metrics.

name: Understat
api_availability: JSON embedded in HTML source (easily extracted via Python)
missing_data_risks: Only top 5 European leagues covered; pre-2014 data unavailable.
licensing: Fair use / Personal. Unclear commercial terms.
intended_purpose: Deep dive into expected attacking metrics and shot-level data for attackers.

name: football-data.co.uk
data_quality: High (industry standard for basic match results)
missing_data_risks: Very low. Missing data is rare.
intended_purpose: Team performance context, league standings, match results, elo-rating generation.

name: EA Sports FIFA/FC Player Attributes (via Kaggle)
data_quality: Subjective (Scout/EA ratings) but highly correlated with real-world perception.
missing_data_risks: Players might be missing if they weren't in the game that year.
licensing: Kaggle specific licenses (often CC0 or fair use for research).
intended_purpose: Baseline proxy for player reputation, physical attributes (pace/strength), and identifying similarity profiles.

name: Fantasy Premier League (FPL) API
seasons_covered: Current and recent seasons via archives
missing_data_risks: Archived historical seasons are harder to query dynamically without community dumps.
licensing: Free for personal/academic use, commercial use restricted by PL.
intended_purpose: Primary backup for player performance metrics (goals, assists, xG) if FBref remains blocked.

name: FotMob API (Unofficial)
python_requests_compatibility: High (standard GET requests with basic headers)
missing_data_risks: Unofficial APIs can change structure without warning.
licensing: Web scraping for academic/personal use generally tolerated.
intended_purpose: Secondary backup for match ratings and granular performance stats.
